title: 学术三态判断：陶片登记
instruction: 阅读完整材料，判断每条陈述：TRUE表示材料支持，FALSE表示材料提供矛盾信息，NOT GIVEN表示材料既未支持也未反驳。只依据本文，不用外部知识补充。
source_notice: 题型参照既存官方学术阅读样题包12—14页：一份自成输入的节选支撑三陈述，TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN，不能用外部知识补信息。官方完整题面/键已核图，原传记史实未另做事实核证，原文本出版许可不转授本项目。新增稿件全为虚构原创案例，不复制原材料；此为高级档的学术任务形式参照，不新增雅思备考档，不证明产品难度、CEFR/分数等值、教师/学生标定、商用或生产通过。其他官方学术阅读具体形式仍待逐项复核。
paragraphs: In a fictional account of a small archaeological survey, an old pottery register became the starting point for a new investigation. Each entry gave a crate number, a brief description and the depth at which a fragment was reportedly found. The register’s first owner had studied several different collections, but the account began with the decision to re-examine this particular set of entries. Several crate numbers had been rewritten in a later hand, making it necessary to distinguish the descriptions of objects from the history of the register itself. The research question concerned whether the recorded depth categories were consistent enough to support a comparison between excavation areas.

The new team found that two excavators had used different meanings for one depth label. To establish this, they compared dated field sketches with register entries that referred to the same crate numbers. The sketches preserved measurements that had been reduced to a single descriptive term in the register. Matching the numbers made it possible to recover the distinction without assuming that identical wording necessarily indicated identical practice. Entries without a corresponding sketch were kept in the catalogue, but the team marked their interpretation as provisional.

When publishing the revised catalogue, the team retained the old descriptions beside the proposed interpretations. Readers could therefore see which changes depended on additional evidence and which entries remained unresolved. The authors rejected a suggestion that they should replace the original wording throughout with a uniform modern label, since doing so would conceal the uncertainty they had uncovered. They also warned against treating a tidier catalogue as evidence that every fragment’s original position had become known. The revised document was intended to expose the limits of the record as much as to improve its usefulness.

questions.stem: The register’s first owner had wanted to become an archaeologist from childhood.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.rationale: TRUE：成年研究多个藏品并不能证明童年志向；FALSE：没有童年相反志向或放弃考古的记录；NOT GIVEN：全文从复核登记册开始，未叙述童年志向，既不支持也不反驳

questions.stem: Shared crate numbers helped the team connect field sketches with register entries.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.evidence_quote: they compared dated field sketches with register entries that referred to the same crate numbers.
questions.rationale: TRUE：相同箱号作为配对依据，明确支持陈述；FALSE：配对方法并未被否定；NOT GIVEN：same crate numbers直接给出方法，非未说明

questions.stem: In the published revision, the original wording was replaced throughout with modern labels.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.evidence_quote: the team retained the old descriptions beside the proposed interpretations.
questions.rationale: TRUE：原文旧描述与新解释并列且拒绝全替换，不支持陈述；FALSE：明确保留旧文并拒绝uniform replacement，与throughout替换矛盾；NOT GIVEN：出版处理明示，不属于缺信息
